title: Add endpoint to change cart quantity
body:
## Summary

Adds PATCH /api/cart/items/:productId so the quantity of a cart line can be changed.

## Changes

* cart.updateItem
* PATCH route in cart routes

## How to test

PATCH /api/cart/items/1 with {"quantity": 3}.

verixa_should_cover: Valid quantity updates the line total
Quantity 0, negative, decimal or text must be rejected (BUG: no validation)
Quantity above stock must be rejected (BUG: not checked)
